bbd44e69cb8906b5c2879dacac024a52.command_line:
set -eu
{
  echo 'PWD='"$PWD"
  echo 'PATH='"$PATH"
  echo 'which caper:'; command -v caper || true
  echo 'which cromwell:'; command -v cromwell || true
  echo 'which java:'; command -v java || true
  echo 'which encode_task_qc_report.py:'; command -v encode_task_qc_report.py || true
  echo 'which atac.wdl:'; find / -xdev -name atac.wdl 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true
  echo 'repo-ish dirs:'; find / -xdev -maxdepth 4 \( -name 'atac-seq-pipeline' -o -name '.caper' -o -name 'scripts' \) 2>/dev/null | head -50 || true
  echo 'caper version:'; caper --version 2>&1 || true
  echo 'java version:'; java -version 2>&1 || true
} > probe.txt
